Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 
 The Community you will join: 
 Our Supply Team is growing, and we want you to be part of it! As a Market Associate / Account Manager, you will play a crucial role in the retention, growth, and optimisation of host entrepreneurs and rising hosts in your assigned territory. These hosts are individuals who manage their own property or support owners by hosting on their behalf. You will focus on building strong relationships with these hosts, helping them optimise their listings, improve pricing strategies, and enhance their overall success on Airbnb.
 The difference you will make: 
 As a Market Associate, you will be responsible for the retention and growth of long-tail Hosts in an assigned territory. You will establish and nurture business relationships with emerging professional host accounts by suggesting and supporting strategic initiatives that drive their success on Airbnb. These initiatives will include supply optimisation, pricing optimisation, host recruitment, and platform education. In addition, as these Hosts successfully grow on the platform, it will be imperative that you help them maintain best-in-class hospitality standards for an excellent guest experience. Beyond one-to-one account management responsibilities, you’ll also support Market Managers on your team to deliver one-to-many education programs, such as webinars and scaled e-mail communication. Ultimately, this team will be responsible for helping long-tail Hosts thrive on Airbnb.
 A typical day:  
- Manage a book of business consisting of host entrepreneurs and rising hosts, ensuring their retention, growth, and optimisation on Airbnb.
- Conduct one-on-one optimisation and onboarding conversations, providing strategic recommendations on pricing, availability, and listing quality.
- Secure availability over high compression dates, ensuring hosts maximise their revenue potential.
- Educate hosts on product updates and policy changes, while channeling their feedback to internal teams.
- Respond to host inquiries and provide timely, high-quality support to improve their experience on the platform.
- Analyse performance data to identify trends and take action on opportunities that drive increased bookings and host success.
- Develop long-lasting relationships with hosts, ensuring they receive ongoing support tailored to their needs.
 Your expertise:  
- 3+ years of experience in new sales, account management, or partner support.
- 2+ years of hospitality/travel industry experience (nice to have).
- Strong time management and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage multiple accounts effectively.
- Proven experience working a book of business, driving engagement and growth through proactive account management.
- Highly goal-driven, with a strong bias for action and persistence in the face of challenges.
- Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage effectively via phone, email, and in-person.
- Proficiency in CRM tools, particularly working with leads and opportunities (Salesforce experience is a plus).
 Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging:

Where some see obstacles, we see the opportunity to find creative, practical solutions, right at the cutting edge.  We are in search of an Associate Legal Counsel for Japan.This role reports to the Associate General Counsel - Northeast Asia and serves as legal partner to many other teams outside Legal. description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 
 The Community You Will Join: 
 Every day, millions of Airbnb hosts around the world create comfortable, reliable and welcoming stays and Experiences for our guests. Hosting on Airbnb offers a unique way to meet our Hosts’ financial goals but the rewards for opening their home or sharing a passion go beyond their bank account. Hosting also offers the opportunity to impact their local community, share their culture and connect with people they wouldn’t have met otherwise.
We know that our global community of hosts is one of Airbnb’s most precious assets and we are very intentional on how we nurture the common identity of being an Airbnb Host. The Airbnb Community team is looking for an experienced Community Engagement Lead to work in the territory and deliver upon our Community Growth, Engagement and business goals.  
 The Difference You will Make: 
 The Airbnb team is looking for a Community Engagement Lead to build and lead our Host Community strategy in Spain and Portugal. You will regionally implement and iterate on Community programs that engage Hosts at scale, such as the Host Clubs program and Host events, while also innovating and testing new methods that can influence and strengthen the global community strategy.
 In this role, Community custodians in each region are responsible for balancing the needs of our Hosting Community with those of Airbnb. You will work closely with and report to the Community Regional Lead and build collaborative relationships with the relevant Country Manager, Policy, Legal, Marketing and Communications Leads, supply teams and central Community team to support our hosts. 
 The ideal candidate has extensive Community experience and knowledge, especially in developing Community strategies as well as building and maintaining programs that connect and engage at scale.  
 A Typical Day:  
 Overall:
- Act as the primary bridge between the local Airbnb team and the Host Community, coordinating and prioritizing cross functional activities that entail community action across the territory
- Lead Community growth, engagement and impact projects and initiatives from planning to delivery. This includes developing project plans, collaborating with cross-functional teams, coordinating multiple stakeholders, identifying project risks and crafting mitigation plans.
- Develop and execute local Community Programs with clear communication, efficient resource usage, and a deep focus on overall project execution.
- Collaborate across functions to drive meaningful impact within Airbnb and its Host Community, working closely with Country Manager, the policy, legal, communications, marketing, partnerships, and supply teams. 
- Coordinate the activities and daily operations of one Community Engagement Manager.

We have a huge responsibility to our community of Hosts and guests to be there when things don’t go exactly as planned with their reservations. We have a lot of work to do in the coming years and we are looking for someone who will help us manage all of the things that need to be done to deliver best-in-class services to our community.    
 The Difference You Will Make: 
 As a Complex Claims Manager in the Complex Claims,  you will play a vital role in safeguarding the integrity of our Aircover platform by effectively identifying, investigating, and managing  the risk and mitigation strategies in resolution of Complex and Large Loss claims.
 You'll manage partners to influence prioritization, drive accountability, deliver improvements, and scale changes on claims which impact Airbnb. You'll work with internal and external partners to influence prioritization, drive accountability, and deliver improvements.  
 You will work closely with cross-functional teams to manage emerging risks / threats while enabling business growth in various markets. Philosophy will be to identify intelligence / risk gaps and work with other internal risk management teams (such as Trust team, and Safety team), third party adjusters, our partners, Platform Product Management, Global Crisis Management, Community support, Policy, Privacy Legal teams to strengthen Airbnb’s platform.
 You will be reporting at Monthly, Quarterly and Annual Business Reviews for your area. You will serve as a thought leader with stakeholders such as Trust, Legal, Privacy, Safety, Product Management, Policy, and understand how the policy/product roadmap impacts risk mitigation of emerging threats. 
 A Typical Day:  
- Management, Policy, and understanding how the policy/product roadmap impacts risk and exposure mitigation. 
- Builds partnerships and is responsible for engaging in the Large Loss Claim reviews with our insurers on a monthly / quarterly basis depending upon the insurer/market.  Ensure we are managing insurers claim handling and potential coverage/relationship issues as well as material reserve changes that could impact Airbnb and the Captive. 
- Craft a Resolution Plan for Complex and Large Loss Claims driving the Carrier and/or TPA to resolve the claim while meeting the needs of internal stakeholders.
- Partner with Legal, GCM, Trust and our Brokers, Insurers, Outside Counsel, and TPA’s on complex claims resolution which may also involve coverage issues and settlement authority.
- Accountable for performance and results Insurance Carrier and Partners worldwide over Complex Claims which may impact policy limits or trigger need of notice to Brokers and Carriers under the insuring policies.
- Mentorship of L6 and L7 Host Damage Protection and Host Liability Protection Specialist on claims.  Works to upskill L6 and L7 partners for growth and development.  Supports the team by guiding through complex claims and changes. 
- Management of claims which impact Airbnb Financials and the Captive.
- Work closely with cross-functional teams to manage the Risk and Exposure on Complex and Large Loss Claims. 
- Collaborate with internal departments, such as other Aircover Ops teams, legal, Trust, CS safety to share claim  insights, improve claim handling by our Carriers and TPA’s while developing a Resolution Plan to bring a claim to the correct conclusion.
- Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and legal requirements related to claims handling
- Mentor to others by simplifying complex information which includes claims knowledge, data analysis, business information, and process obstacles.

description:

Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way. 
 La communauté qui vous attend : 
 Le directeur ou la directrice principal·e de la qualité des niveaux de volume, est le ou la seul·e responsable de la mesure de la qualité, des données et de l'amélioration continue pour toutes les fonctions de soutien à la communauté d'Airbnb de plus grand volume. Ce rôle est responsable du programme de qualité de bout en bout pour : 
- Anglais mondial (GE)
- Reste du monde (ROW, qui comprend 9 langues différentes)
- Soutien supérieur
 Les programmes Anglais mondial et Reste du monde couvrent plusieurs niveaux de service : résolutions 1, 2 et 3, Soutien au service dédié (DSS), Soutien géré dédié aux hôtes (DMHS), et ils sont soutenus par un réseau mondial de partenaires opérant en tout temps dans des dizaines de langues.
 Votre contribution : 
 Il s'agit d'un poste de direction de haut niveau qui se situe au croisement de la stratégie et de l'exécution. Le directeur ou la directrice principal·e de la qualité éliminera le cloisonnement au sein de l'organisation de la qualité, établira un modèle opérationnel unifié et utilisera des outils basés sur l'IA pour développer les données sur la qualité. Il ou elle travaillera en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de prestation de services, de formation, d'amélioration des processus opérationnels et d'autres parties prenantes pour assurer l'alignement sur les priorités, régler les problèmes et veiller à ce qu'Airbnb fournisse à son réseau mondial de partenaires un ensemble unifié de priorités. 
 Le candidat ou la candidate retenu·e s'imposera comme un partenaire crédible auprès des parties prenantes et jouera un rôle de porte-parole de la qualité pour le portefeuille des niveaux de volume à l'interne.
 Journée type :  
 Leadership stratégique et responsabilité du programme 
- Prendre en charge et exécuter la stratégie de qualité pour les niveaux de volume en fonction de plusieurs priorités essentielles : éliminer le cloisonnement, s'aligner avec les parties prenantes, définir un modèle opérationnel clair et générer un impact mesurable.
- Consolider les cadres d'assurance qualité fragmentés des programmes Anglais mondial et Reste du monde en un modèle opérationnel unifié, en éliminant les processus incohérents, les approches divergentes pour les mauvais indices de recommandation client et les signaux de qualité incompatibles.
- Présenter la qualité des niveaux de volume pendant les réunions sur les rapports d'activités hebdomadaires, mensuelles et trimestrielles, et dans les forums de planification interfonctionnels, en plus d'apporter une perspective proactive et narrative qui donne de la visibilité à la direction avant que des problèmes ne soient signalés pendant des examens opérationnels.
 Mesure et exécution de la qualité 
- Superviser l'exécution de l'évaluation de l'assurance qualité sur tous les sites partenaires des niveaux de volume dans le monde entier en assurant l'application cohérente des processus et des cadres d'assurance qualité.
- Mener des analyses des causes profondes des défaillances systémiques, en traduisant les conclusions issues de l'assurance qualité en recommandations relatives aux produits, aux processus et aux politiques qui vont au-delà de l'accompagnement des agents.
- Formaliser l'audit de l'auditeur en tant que contrôle continu : définir la sélection des échantillons, les seuils d'alignement, l'analyse des causes profondes et les processus de correction au niveau des évaluateurs.
- Veiller à ce que chaque évaluation se termine par une mesure d'accompagnement formalisée et mettre en place des mécanismes de suivi permettant de déterminer si cet accompagnement se traduit par une amélioration du rendement au fil du temps.
 Observations, rapports et partenariat avec les parties prenantes 
- Établir des rapports d'indicateurs clés de performance automatisés pour tous les sites, tous les niveaux et toutes les langues des niveaux de volume en éliminant les processus manuels. 
- Unifier l'analyse des mauvais indices de recommandation client dans l'ensemble des programmes Anglais mondial et Reste du monde pour mettre en évidence en temps réel des tendances globales.
- Élaborer une fiche d'évaluation du rendement des partenaires en matière d'assurance qualité en définissant clairement les responsabilités relatives à la précision de l'étalonnage, à l'exhaustivité de l'évaluation, à la détection des erreurs critiques et à l'efficacité de l'accompagnement.

In NVIDIA’s Enterprise Product Group, we help enterprise and community developers use NVIDIA software and hardware across cloud and on-premises environments.  Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 Title and Summary 
Senior Managing, Technical Deploy for LAC, Advisors & Consulting Services 
Overview
Lead the technical design and architecture strategy of complex client engagements, ensuring solutions are scalable, feasible, secure, and aligned with Mastercard standards. Transform technical knowledge into reusable regional assets and act as the primary architecture authority within Tech Deploy.
Role
Lead technical discovery, solution shaping and architecture design for strategic client opportunities.
Define solution architectures, integration strategies, implementation approaches and technical roadmaps.
Validate technical feasibility, risks, dependencies and delivery readiness in partnership with other business and technical roles.
Vendor management, reviewing architectures, estimates and implementation approaches.
Establish architecture standards, reusable patterns and governance practices.
Mentor architects and technical specialists while helping define future Tech Deploy capabilities and squads.
Drive knowledge retention through reference architectures, playbooks and artifacts with an industrialization mindset.
All About You
Required
Bachelor's degree in engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems or related field.
10+ years of experience in solution architecture, enterprise architecture, software engineering, integration or technical consulting.
Strong experience designing complex enterprise solutions and system integrations.
Experience with APIs, integration patterns, cloud platforms, security and modern application architectures.
Ability to lead technical discussions with clients, vendors and C-level stakeholders, with a business alignment approach
Excellent communication and documentation skills.
Preferred
Master's degree.
Experience in payments, fintech, digital banking or financial services.
Knowledge of Mastercard products and ecosystem.
Experience with AI, Data, Open Banking or Digital Payments solutions.
Experience managing distributed teams, vendors, or architecture governance boards. 
 Corporate Security Responsibility 
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
 - Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
- Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
- Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
- Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

description:
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with strong infrastructure expertise to design, build, and operate the next generation of our enterprise Automation, and AI-driven Reliability Platform. 
 This role involves developing and implement innovative architecture and software for large-scale storage and backup services, ensuring continuous availability, performance, and self-service for all key services supporting our AI/ML, Software and engineering teams. This position offers a rare chance to contribute to revenue-driving initiatives and the foundation of our engineering services. 
 What you'll be doing: 
 - Develop and manage enterprise-scale platforms that unify storage infrastructure and services, integrating enterprise appliances, networks, and open-source technologies. 
 - Develop and scale REST APIs in Python/Go, enabling thousands of engineers to seamlessly run on-demand storage workflows. 
 - Automate storage operations — provisioning, monitoring, metrics, telemetry, and solving — ensuring high reliability and performance. 
 - Integrate intelligent observability and tracing into workflows to improve accuracy, reduce latency, and optimize efficiency across infrastructure services. 
 - Implement agentic workflows that empower self-healing, proactive remediation, and automation to decrease operational overhead. 
 - Build proof-of-concept integrations between infrastructure services and emerging agentic AI frameworks, laying the foundation for intelligent infrastructure platforms. 
 - Document practices and procedures, evaluate new technologies, and drive adoption of next-gen automation in enterprise storage services. 
 What we need to see: 
 - BS in Computer Science (or equivalent experience) with 12+ years of relevant experience, MS with 10+ years, or Ph.D. with 8+ years. 
 - Extensive expertise building large-scale, multi-threaded, distributed backend systems. 
 - Experience designing and building RESTful APIs using Python or Go. 
 - Familiarity with containerization & orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes). 
 - Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). 
 - Experience with telemetry stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, Alert manager, ELK/Kibana). 
 - Ability to collaborate across teams and communicate technical solutions effectively. 
 - Growth mindset to quickly adopt new frameworks in observability, AI automation, and infrastructure management. 
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 - Contributions to open-source projects (infrastructure, storage, or Python-based libraries). 
 - Strong background in Linux storage systems and solving at enterprise scale. 
 - Experience with Enterprise NAS (NetApp, Pure Storage), distributed filesystems (Lustre, GPFS, Ceph), or S3-compatible object storage. 
 - Experience with GenAI/agentic application frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen) or observability platforms (LangSmith, Arize Phoenix, W&B Weave). 
 - Proven track record to prototype and productionize intelligent automation workflows, especially for self-service, large-scale infrastructure.

description:
Adobe Risk Platform (ARP) is Adobe's centralized, adaptive system for detecting, preventing, and mitigating fraud and abuse across products and services, delivering robust security without degrading customer experience. It protects surfaces like Commerce, Stock, and Firefly with real-time risk decisions.
As a Sr Staff Engineer on ARP, you'll set the architectural direction for risk mitigation across Adobe. You'll define the standards, patterns, and long-term technical strategy that let ARP and Adobe stay ahead of fraud and abuse as it evolves.
 What you'll do
 - Architect systems built for the next three to five years of risk mitigation, while delivering impact iteratively and solving today's most important priorities along the way.
- Push the platform to the forefront of AI and ML to strengthen fraud and abuse detection.
- Lay the foundational building blocks of the Risk Platform that future risk-mitigation capability builds on, including the platform's shift toward event-driven, continuously-reasoning risk intelligence.
- Set architectural standards for risk-decisioning services that other teams across Adobe adopt.
- Share architectural thinking broadly, through design docs that become org-wide standards, white papers, tech talks, or cross-org design reviews.
- Simplify complex, interlinked systems into designs other teams can build on with confidence.
- Mentor senior and staff engineers across teams, growing the next generation of technical leaders.
 What you need to succeed 
 - Bachelor's or advanced degree in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience; Master's preferred.
- 12+ years architecting high-scale, highly performant platforms, and leading the technical teams that build them.
- Deep understanding of AI and ML, both to strengthen fraud detection and to counter AI-powered attacks.
- Deep expertise in distributed systems and databases, including SQL, NoSQL, and DynamoDB-class stores.
- Track record architecting systems with multi-year relevancy, not just solving today's scaling or reliability problem.
- Experience with data lakes and large-scale data platforms like Databricks or Spark.
- Proven ability to influence engineering direction across teams and Business Units without formal authority.
- A track record of publishing or presenting technical work that shaped how others build.
 Nice to have 
 - Experience with graph databases or identity/relationship graphs applied to fraud or abuse detection (e.g., detecting rings, relay networks, or coordinated account abuse via graph traversal).
- Device fingerprinting or AI agent design experience.
- A payments, commerce, or fraud background.
- Familiarity with regulatory and compliance constraints relevant to payments and fraud decisioning (e.g., PCI, regional payment regulations).

Job Details: 
 Job Description: 
 Intel is shaping the future of technology to help create a better future for the entire world. Our work in pushing forward fields like AI, analytics, and cloud-to-edge technology is at the heart of countless innovations. With a career at Intel, you'll have the opportunity to use technology to power major breakthroughs and create enhancements that improve our everyday quality of life. Join us and help make the future more wonderful for everyone.
 Life at Intel 
We developed the Intel microprocessors, a foundational technology that powers a diverse range of devices-from entry-level PCs to high-end gaming desktops and laptops, as well as data center solutions and many other applications. As part of our team, you will help design the next generation of high-performance microprocessors. We are looking for a skilled individual who is hands-on with RTL implementation for integer, floating point and reservation station logic and can provide technical leadership to deliver world-class products.
As a CPU RTL Logic Design Engineer your responsibilities will include but are not limited to:
• Collaborates, drives and develops logic design, register transfer level (RTL) coding, and simulation for a CPU required to generate cell libraries, functional units, and the CPU IP block for integration in full chip designs.
• Participates actively in the definition of architecture and microarchitecture features of the CPU being designed.
• Applies various strategies, tools, and methods to write RTL and optimize logic to qualify the design to meet power, performance, area, and timing goals as well as design integrity for physical implementation.
• Reviews the verification plan and implementation to ensure design features are verified correctly and resolves and implements corrective measures for failing RTL tests to ensure correctness of features.
• Technical Guidance: Provide technical leadership and support to the design team leadership including proposing creative, innovative methodology and process initiatives to consistently improve efficiency and quality.
• Cross team collaboration: Work closely with architecture and backend teams and with other design teams towards achieving best-in-class products.
• Build a strong and technically vital organization. Cultivate and reinforce appropriate group values, norms and behaviors.
Behavioral traits that we are looking for:
• Excellent in problem-solving, analytical.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and collaborative environment.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, Engineering, or related field with 8+ years of work experience OR
• Master's degree in Computer Science, Electrical, Electronics, Engineering, or related field with 7+ years of work experience OR

We are now packing tens of billions of transistors in a chip to meet the growing computing demand. We are looking for a top ASIC Design Engineer to join our team. In this role, you should have real passion for RTL design implementation and methodologies that enable high quality system-level IP design.
 What you'll be doing: 
 - Be an integral part of the team defining and developing system-level RTL and methodologies to measure performance on the industry's leading GPUs/SOCs.
- Design and implement RTL features - work through the entire design cycle for SOC.
- Run and debug RTL checks to ensure design quality (e.g. CDC, RDC, Lint, Synthesis, Logic-Equivalence and more)
- Define, develop, and automate flows and methodologies to efficiently build and support a system-level IP
- Work with architects, designers, verification and SW engineers to accomplish your tasks.
 What we need to see: 
 - B.Tech or M.Tech in Electronics or Computer Engineering.
- 3+ years of relevant industry experience.
- Experienced in RTL design (Verilog), System-On-Chip design/implementation flows, and design automation.
- Good understanding of SOC/IP (u)architecture (e.g., data flow, control, multiple clock/power domains handling, latency analysis).
- Strong coding skills in Perl, Python or other industry-standard scripting languages.
- Excellent debugging and analytical skills.
- Exposure to design and verification tools (dc_shell or equivalent synthesis tools, VCS or equivalent simulation tools, debug tools like Debussy, GDB).
- Great communication and collaboration skills to interact within the team and with cross functional teams.
- Adept at using AI tools to enhance productivity and solve complicated problems
 NVIDIA is widely considered one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We employ some of the most forward-thinking and innovative people in the world. Are you passionate about joining our life’s work to amplify human imagination and intelligence? If you are creative, collaborative, and have real passion for design, methodology, and automation, we want to hear from you!

description:
职责概述 
 医学信息沟通地区经理负责管理所辖区域的一切业务，包括制订和实施区域的工作目标和发展计划，建立一个绩效良好、极富生产力和士气高昂的团队。对客户的需求做出适当反应以实现区域的各项工作 目标。对医学信息沟通专员的行为进行规范和监管，对他们的专业技能提升和学习发展规划提供辅导和支 
 持。 
 主要工作和任务 
 1.    制订并执行所辖区域的业务计划，推动团队实现公司和上级经理下达的各项工作目标和任 务。 
 2.    招聘符合公司基本要求的人员（包括各种雇佣形式和编制），定期对团队成员进行绩效和行为的评估，实施奖惩或激励措施。 
 3.    制订并执行培养团队成员合规意识的计划，规范其工作行为，确保各项活动的真实性和合规性。 
 4.    制订并执行提升团队成员的专业知识和技能的计划，并对其个人发展规划提供指导与支持。 
 5.    通过有计划的随访，在与专员讨论区域业务及市场活动时对其进行针对性的辅导。 
 6.    监控和分析市场发展趋势，挖掘区域市场机会，为公司策略的制订提供反馈和建议。 
 7.    协调并有效地实施各个项目及活动，合理分配和控制各项资源。有效管理项目和活动的流程，确保其真实有效地开展。 
 8.    与区域内关键客户保持持续的沟通，建立并持续优化合作伙伴关系。 
 9.    熟悉对当前及未来业务有影响的政策，必要情况下可根据公司的要求，与相关职能部门合作，参与或协调所辖区域的市场准入工作。 
 10. 建立和保持有效沟通系统，包括定期召开地区会议，定期与上级经理汇报区域工作进展，与其他部门建立协作关系。 
 11. 为制订和修改业务相关的政策和流程及其他内部政策提供建议，以实现高效率的业务运作。 
 12. 支持公司的各项创新举措，带领团队成员执行新举措，并且主动探索创新的机会和方法。 
 13. 完成上级经理指派的其他各项工作。 
 任职要求 
 ·             教育： 
 -           大学专科及以上学历，医学，药学，生命科学等相关专业优先。 
 ·             技能： 
 -           熟练使用 MS Office ，英语良好。 
 -           具备较好的相关产品领域的专业知识。 
 -           具备较强的影响力和策略性思维能力。 
 -           具备较强的沟通，计划，组织和问题解决能力。 
 -           具备较强的团队合作意识。 
 -           具备较强的学习意愿和学习能力。 
 -           善于自我激励，自我挑战和管理压力。 
 ·             经验： 
 -           至少 3 年制药行业同等公司的医药代表工作经验，具备符合合规要求的优秀的绩效记录 , 具备管理 潜力。 
 -           有制药行业业务管理经验者优先。 
 ·             诚信： 
 -           能够严格管理自己的行为，确保日常工作全部遵循公司政策、行业准则以及相关法律，包括但 不限于 FCPA ( 《反海外腐败法》 ) 及相关中国大陆境内相关反腐法律条款。严守诚信，保持真 实透明，在过往的工作中无任何违反法律规定的行为发生。 
 ·             内部申请资格： 
 -           内部申请人需符合现行合规调查流程，处分等级 & 时限等的要求。 
 -           至少有 2 年以上辉瑞医药代表工作经验；萌芽优先。 
 -           过去两年的绩效， 需达到或超过团队平均水平。 
 核心能力 
 专业合规 : 
 打造专业团队 – 评估专员的专业知识和技能的掌握和应用情况，利用各种方式提升团队成员的专业知识和技 能。 
 打造合规团队 – 理解合规各项规定的意义和原则， 培养团队成员的合规意识，规范团队成员的合规行为，防 范合规风险。 
 业务决断 : 
 有效规划业务 – 制定业务计划时既紧密结合大区策略，又把握地区特点和规律。系统分析市场 – 通过对区域市场，客户和政策信息的综合分析形成市场洞察。 
 客户融动 : 
 优化伙伴关系 – 深入理解并引导客户需求，建立并优化合作伙伴关系。 
 推动合作共赢 – 理解合作部门的工作目标和重点，当需要时能整合公司资源，推动内部合作。 
 组织发展 : 
 激发团队士气 – 明确团队管理规则，激发团队士气和凝聚力。 
 辅导发展他人 – 关注员工的发展， 通过辅导和支持来提升员工的能力。 
 自主执行 : 
 推动团队达成 – 准确制定团队工作计划，通过监督和跟进推动团队实现目标。 
 勇于承担责任 – 为团队的绩效结果负责，为实现公司的目标愿意承担起额外责任。 
 自我发展 : 
 自主规划发展 – 洞察自身优势和不足，制定并执行个人发展计划以促进持续学习，主动寻找并利用提升自身 能力的机会和资源。 
 创新变革 : 
 积极探索创新 – 正确理解并引导团队积极面对各种变化，积极探索工作中的创新机会。

 Intel is shaping the future of technology to help create a better future for the entire world. Our work in pushing forward fields like AI, analytics, and cloud-to-edge technology is at the heart of countless innovations.  Job Description: 
 About the Role 
 The CEG NAG (Networking Architecture Group) is Intel's premier team focused on defining the future of high-performance networking silicon. Our team architects next-generation networking solutions that enable hyperscale data centers, cloud infrastructure, and AI workloads to achieve unprecedented performance and efficiency. We specialize in IPU/DPU platforms, advanced packet processing architectures, and programmable networking technologies that form the backbone of modern distributed computing systems.
 We are seeking a Senior SoC Compute & Memory Architect to define and drive the architecture of compute complexes and high-performance memory subsystems for next-generation IPU/DPU platforms.
 This role is responsible for end-to-end architecture of CPU clusters, cache hierarchies, coherency models, and memory subsystems. You will optimize system-level performance, scalability, power efficiency, and programmability while ensuring seamless interaction with networking, storage, and accelerator subsystems in hyperscale environments.
 What You’ll Do 
 Key responsibilities will include but not limited to: 
 Cache Hierarchy and Coherency Architecture 
1. Define and evolve multi-level cache hierarchy (private/shared caches, system-level cache).
2. Architect coherency models across compute cores, accelerators, and IO subsystems (coherent vs non-coherent interactions).
3. Evaluate tradeoffs between latency, bandwidth, scalability, and coherence domain complexity.
 Memory Subsystem Architecture 
1. Architect system memory subsystems including:
-DDR / LPDDR interfaces.
-Memory controllers and scheduling policies.
-Bandwidth provisioning and scaling strategies.
2. Work with Performance architect in define memory access models for compute, network, and accelerator subsystems.
3. Ensure optimal balance between latency-sensitive control workloads and bandwidth-intensive datapath workloads.
 IO Memory and Virtualization Architecture (SMMU/IOMMU) 
1. Define architecture for SMMU/IOMMU supporting virtualization-heavy IPU workloads.
2. Architect features such as:
-Multi-tenant isolation and security boundaries.
-Shared vs isolated memory models.
3. Ensure efficient interaction between host, IPU/DPU compute, and offload engines.
 System-Level Integration (Compute Network Storage) 
1. Architect integration between:
-Compute subsystem.
-Network subsystem (packet processing pipelines).
-Storage and accelerator subsystems.
2. Optimize data movement across subsystems to minimize copies, latency, and bandwidth overhead.
3. Drive system architecture decisions for balanced SoC performance.
 Power, Efficiency, and Scaling Strategy 
1. Define compute and memory strategies for power efficiency and DVFS scalability.
2. Architect mechanisms for:
-Memory bandwidth throttling / prioritization.
-Per-subsystem scaling.
3. Optimize performance-per-watt at system level.
 Multi-Generation Architecture Roadmap 
1. Lead long-term roadmap for compute and memory evolution across IPU/DPU product generations.
2. Define scaling strategies for:
-Core count and frequency.
-Memory bandwidth and capacity.
-Cache scaling and topology.
3. Ensure backward compatibility and smooth migration across product lines.
 Cross-Functional Leadership 
1. Collaborate with teams across:
-Networking subsystem (NSS).
-SoC fabric/interconnect.
-Firmware, OS, and drivers.
-Validation and performance modeling and testing.
2. Drive architecture alignment and resolve cross-domain tradeoff.

 - Architectural vision: Defines long-term strategy across system domains.
- Influence without authority: Drives alignment across multiple teams and disciplines.
- Systems thinking: Understands interactions across compute, memory, network, and software.
- Decision-making under ambiguity: Makes sound tradeoffs with incomplete data.
- Collaboration: Builds strong cross-functional relationships.
- Customer-oriented mindset: Translates workload needs into architectural innovations.
- Ownership and accountability: Drives initiatives end-to-end.
- Continuous learning: Stays current with evolving compute and memory technologies.

Our Purpose 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 Title and Summary 
Director, Infrastructure & Site Reliability Engineering 
Who is Mastercard?
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. 
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all. 
Overview
Are you a visionary leader who thrives on driving transformation in complex infrastructure environments? Do you excel at building high-performing teams, fostering innovation, and aligning technology with business outcomes? The Distributed Platform Operations team is seeking a Director of Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) to lead strategic initiatives that ensure the reliability, scalability, and performance of our VMware and Oracle Linux platforms.
This role is ideal for a seasoned leader who combines deep technical expertise with a passion for operational excellence, automation, and cross-functional collaboration.
Key Responsibilities
• Define and execute the strategic roadmap for Site Reliability Engineering across distributed platforms.
• Lead modernization efforts including hardware lifecycle management, virtualization upgrades, and infrastructure optimization.
• Champion a culture of automation, resilience, and continuous improvement.
• Build, mentor, and scale a high-impact SRE organization with a focus on technical excellence and career development.
• Establish clear objectives, performance metrics, and development plans for team members.
• Promote knowledge sharing and operational maturity through documentation and onboarding programs.
• Oversee the health and performance of VMware clusters, ESXi hosts, and Oracle Linux environments.
• Ensure robust disaster recovery and high availability strategies are in place and tested.

 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 Title and Summary 
Director, Product Management - Tokenized Deposits 
Overview
Tokenized deposits bring commercial bank money onto programmable infrastructure, enabling new forms of digital payments, settlement, and financial services. Mastercard is developing the interoperability capabilities required for bank-issued tokenized deposits to operate across institutions, platforms, blockchain networks, and other forms of digital money. 
The Director, Product Management, Tokenized Deposits will lead the strategy, development, and commercialization of Mastercard’s tokenized deposit capabilities. The role requires a product leader who can translate emerging digital-asset technologies and customer needs into secure, scalable, and commercially viable products.
Role
 • Define and execute the product strategy and roadmap for Tokenized Deposits, translating customer needs, market developments, and emerging digital-asset capabilities into scalable products.
 • Lead product development across the tokenized deposit lifecycle, including issuance enablement, transfer, programmability, interoperability, acceptance, clearing, and settlement.
 • Develop capabilities that enable tokenized deposits to operate across financial institutions, blockchain networks, applications, and other forms of digital money.
 • Translate complex technical and business requirements into clear product specifications, architecture decisions, delivery priorities, and commercialization plans.
 • Partner with engineering, architecture, design, legal, compliance, risk, regional teams, financial institutions, and technology providers to take capabilities from concept through pilot, launch, and scale.
 • Engage customers and ecosystem partners to identify priority use cases, validate product requirements, structure pilots, and drive adoption.
 • Define product operating models, governance, integration approaches, and implementation guidance that support secure and scalable participation by banks and ecosystem partners.
 • Establish product success metrics and use customer feedback, pilot outcomes, and market insights to continuously refine the roadmap.
All About You
 • Significant product management or product development experience in digital assets, payments, banking infrastructure, or other technically complex financial products.
 • Experience owning products from initial concept and customer discovery through technical development, pilot execution, commercialization, and scale.
 • Strong understanding of crypto and digital-asset infrastructure, including blockchain networks, smart contracts, wallets, custody, tokenization, and integration with traditional banking and payment systems.
 • Engineering experience or a strong technical background, with the ability to work closely with engineers and architects on APIs, distributed ledgers, smart contracts, integration flows, security models, and platform architecture.
 • Understanding of commercial bank money, payment execution, clearing and settlement, liquidity, and the operational and regulatory considerations associated with bank-issued digital money.
 • Experience translating complex technical concepts into clear product strategies, requirements, executive recommendations, and partner-facing documentation.
 • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional delivery across engineering, architecture, legal, compliance, risk, security, regional, and commercialization teams.
 • Strong customer and ecosystem orientation, with experience engaging financial institutions, digital-asset infrastructure providers, blockchain networks, wallet providers, and technology platforms.
 • Comfortable operating in an emerging product area, combining strategic thinking with hands-on execution and sound product judgment.
 • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage credibly with engineers, senior executives, customers, and external partners.

 Job Description: 
 About the Group 
 Intel Foundry is a systems foundry dedicated to transforming the global semiconductor industry by delivering cutting-edge silicon process and packaging technology leadership for the AI era. Come join us and do something wonderful.

 Core Competencies

description:
【职责概述】 
 医学信息沟通大区经理负责管理所辖区域的一切业务，包括制订和实施区域的工作目标和发展计划，建立一个绩效良好、极富生产力和士气高昂的团队。对客户的需求做出适当反应以实现区域的各项工作目标。对团队成员的行为进行规范和监管，对他们的专业技能提升和学习发展规划提供辅导和支持。
 【主要工作和任务】 
 1.     制订并执行所辖区域的业务计划，推动大区各个团队实现公司和上级下达的各项工作目标和任务。
 2.     招聘符合公司基本要求的人员，定期对团队成员进行绩效和行为的评估，实施奖惩或激励措施。
 3.     制订并执行培养团队成员合规意识的计划，规范员工的工作行为，确保各项活动的真实性和合规性。
 4.     制订并执行团队成员专业知识和技能的发展计划，通过随访对团队成员定期进行教导，以加强其专业能力、产品知识、产品策略、医学信息沟通技巧和总体工作效率，并对其个人发展规划提供指导与支持。
 5.     根据大区业务发展的方向进行人力资源分配和人才规划，促进区域健康良性发展，建立人才梯队，保留高绩效人才。
 6.     通过跟进计划，各团队的工作汇报和和随访等，深入了解各个团队的工作进展并进行针对性的辅导，包括业务及市场活动，人员管理和辅导，人才发展和保留等工作。
 7.     根据对市场发展趋势的分析，挖掘区域市场机会，打造大区的长期竞争优势。
 8.     协调并组织大区内的重要项目及活动，合理分配和控制各项资源。
 9.     与区域内关键客户保持持续的沟通，前瞻性预测客户学术需求的变化，建立并持续优化战略合作伙伴关系。
 10.   熟悉对当前及未来业务有影响的政策，必要情况下可根据公司的要求，与相关职能部门合作，参与或协调所辖区域的市场准入工作。
 11.   建立和保持有效沟通系统，包括定期召开大区会议，定期与上级汇报区域工作进展，与其他部门建立跨部门沟通和合作关系。
 12.   为制订和修改业务相关的政策和流程及其他内部政策提供建议，以实现高效率的业务运作。
 13.   支持公司的各项创新举措，带领大区各个团队执行新举措，搭建创新平台。
 14.   完成上级经理指派的其他各项工作。
 【任职要求】 
 教育： 
 -       大学本科及以上学历，医学，药学，生命科学等相关专业优先。
 技能： 
 -       熟练使用MS Office，英语良好。
 -       具备较好的相关产品领域的专业知识。
 -       具备较强的领导力和战略思维能力。
 -       具备较强的沟通，计划，组织和问题解决能力。
 -       具备较强的团队合作意识。
 -       具备较强的学习意愿和学习能力。
 -       善于自我激励，自我挑战和管理压力。
 经验： 
 -       至少 3 年制药行业同等公司的业务管理工作经验，具备符合合规要求的，优秀的绩效记录。
 诚信： 
 -       能够严格管理自己的行为，确保日常工作全部遵循公司政策、行业准则以及相关法律，包括但不限于 FCPA (《反海外腐败法》)及相关中国大陆境内相关反腐法律条款。严守诚信，保持真实透明，在过往的工作中无任何违反法律规定的行为发生。
 内部申请资格： 
 -       内部申请人需符合现行合规调查流程，处分等级&时限等的要求。
 -       至少有 2 年辉瑞业务管理工作经验。
 -       过去两年的团队绩效，需达到或超过团队平均水平。
 【核心能力】 
 专业合规: 
 构建专业体系-在大区内建立专业能力标准体系，通过流程和机制提升团队整体的专业能力。
 营造合规氛围-准确理解合规各项规定的意义和原则，培养团队合规意识，规范团队合规行为，防范合规风险。
 业务决断: 
 策略规划业务-策略性地规划大区的业务发展，在抓住市场机会的同时持续打造大区的长期竞争优势。宏观掌控市场-通过数据分析，通盘掌握大区整体市场的变化，并对市场趋势进行预判。
 客户融动: 
 优化合作策略-预测大区客户需求的变化，建立战略合作伙伴关系，通过策略性合作提升辉瑞竞争优势。建立协作机制-建立并优化合作机制，为协作建立共同的目标，并积极推动持续的跨部门沟通和合作。
 组织发展: 
 营造正向氛围-激发团队信息，营造积极的团队氛围。
 搭建人才梯队-通过系统的培养体系提升大区人员的能力，搭建人才梯队。
 自主执行: 
 建立执行机制-在大区内建立和推广高效执行的标准和全面管理机制，在系统及机制层面提升执行效果。勇于全面担责-对于大区的绩效承担最终责任，主动设定挑战性目标促进工作不断优化。
 自我发展: 
 全面完善自我-审视职业理想和目标，寻求和创造学习机会以促进全面素养的提升。
 创新变革: 
 搭建创新平台-主动探索创新和变革的机会，营造创新变革环境，并推动团队变革。

 Adobe seeks a leader to join our Global Government Relations and Public Policy team to advance our efforts in the UK, located in London. This leader will also support Adobe’s policy involvement in Ireland and the Middle East.

The ideal candidate will possess comprehensive knowledge of digital policies in the UK as well as technology procurement policy procedures.  - Development, coordination, and implementation of a successful government relations engagement strategy, including engagement planning for senior leaders.
- Take ownership of Adobe's engagement with UK regulatory authorities on sensitive, active matters, working closely with Legal and senior collaborators and managing confidential communications.

- Work autonomously and engage with senior leadership to drive impact.
- Ensure Adobe is well positioned and follows all relevant regulations and requirements.
- Develop and advocate for external policy positions which improve Adobe’s position in the marketplace.

description:
NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself. Our invention of the GPU sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing. Today, research in artificial intelligence is booming worldwide, which calls for highly scalable and massively parallel computation horsepower that NVIDIA GPUs excel.
 NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities that are hard to solve, that only we can address, and that matter to the world. Come join our diverse team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world!
 What you’ll be doing: 
 - Be part of NVIDIA Power Architecture Group that owns end-to-end power aspects such as - ASIC power analysis, power architecture, low power design, power-aware verification, advanced power methodologies, UPF methodologies, power feature bring-up on silicon, and post-Si power correlation for NVIDIA's family of products.
- Contributing to power analysis by helping to architect, develop, verify & correlate power estimation models/tools for NVIDIA's products
- Be part of the team that architects & designs system-level power features for optimizing the dynamic and leakage power dissipation for different usecases.
- Work on power verification which includes structural, functional & power aware verification of power features of NVIDIA products by coming up with test plans, write testcases, build test bench components like Monitors, assertions and coverage points & own verification convergence across RTL, Gates and Silicon.
- Validate the effectiveness of the power features on silicon, conduct studies and contribute to the Performance/Watt improvement ideas.
- Help build power management solutions and drive innovation in energy efficiency across NVIDIA’s product portfolio.
 What we need to see: 
 - B.Tech./M.Tech with 2+ years of experience related to Power such as Power analysis, Power Design, Power Aware Verification, UPF methodologies and Power Correlation
- Strong fundamentals in power including transistor-level leakage/dynamic characteristics of VLSI circuits
- Strong fundamentals in digital design and verilog
- Familiarity with low power design techniques such as multi-VT, Clock gating, Power gating, Voltage Islands and Dynamic Voltage-Frequency Scaling (DVFS)
- Good background in power estimation techniques, flows and algorithms
- Knowledge of power intent formats - UPF/CPF or similar
- Experience in Static Power check tools like VCLP/CLP or similar & Dynamic Power verification tools like VCS-NLP or equivalent
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 - Strong debugging and problem-solving skills
- Good communication skills and ability & desire to work as a great teammate
- Good programming skills - Python preferred (Good skills with object-oriented programming & design) preferred.
- Exposure to Power analysis tools (such as PTPX, EPS) or exposure to lab setups for power measurements like scope/DAQ with ability to analyze board level power issues is a plus

description:
We are now looking for a Senior Circuit Timing Engineer!
 NVIDIA stands at the intersection of hardware excellence and AI breakthrough, where every line of code and every chip design ripples across industries worldwide. We've built the computational backbone for autonomous systems, revolutionized data center architecture, and created the silicon that powers the AI revolution. Our resilience through decades of technological shifts has forged a unique engineering culture—one where ambitious projects meet exceptional talent. From deep learning frameworks to cutting-edge robotics, we're not just participants in the fourth industrial revolution; we're its architects. Discover how your engineering vision can reshape the world alongside ours.
 What you'll be doing: 
 - Participate in ground breaking processor design in deep submicron technologies. 
- Work as part of a global circuits team to design innovative circuits for hardware security, adaptive clocking, and power management solutions. 
- Drive timing analysis and signoff of custom circuit macros (digital, semi-custom and analog mixed-signal). 
- Validate timing of custom circuit designs using STA tools including Nanotime, PrimeTime, Tempus and various SPICE simulation tools. 
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve the power, performance, area and reliability of NVIDIA's next generation products through custom circuit solutions and detailed transistor-level analysis. 
- Develop timing models and methodology for innovative and unique custom macro designs. 
- Transistor-level circuit design and timing, schematic entry, and layout delivery. 
- Integrate AI/ML techniques directly into the design process and methodology. 
- Work with PD, DFX, Clocks, and other teams on timing signoff strategy, timing constraints, timing and power convergence, DFT, as well as timing ECO implementation. 
 What we need to see: 
 - BSEE/MS preferred in Electrical, Computer Engineering or equivalent experience. 
- 6+ years of digital circuit design experience for Masters and 8+ years for Bachelors. 
- Excellent understanding of deep submicron process issues and digital circuit design techniques is required. 
- Expertise and in-depth knowledge of industry standard STA tools such as Nanotime, Primetime, Tempus, and other timing analysis tools. 
- Hands on experience running Spice simulations, EM/IR analysis, and static timing analysis/closure is required. 
- Proven experience in timing constraints generation and management. 
- Hands on experience in design and analysis of low power circuits (power gating, decaps, multi-vt, etc..) is a plus. 
- Expertise in analysis and fixing of timing paths through ECOs including crosstalk and glitch noise. 
- Solid understanding of extracted timing models and the usage of .libs in Primetime. 
- Knowledge of process variation effect modeling and experience in design convergence in multi GHz deep submicron technology. 
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 - Proven ownership and hands-on experience across the entire silicon design flow, from micro-architecture and RTL design to back-end execution, including Custom/Semi-Custom Circuit Design, Synthesis, Auto Place and Route, STA, and PVerf. 
- Proven capability in Post-Silicon characterization and debug, ensuring designs meet performance targets in hardware. 
- Track record of independently driving and delivering complex features from conception through tape-out and validation. 
- Knowledge of timing closure strategies for digital logic/macros part of AMS designs/IPs.

description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.
 If you want to challenge yourself and be a part of something great, join us today! NVIDIA has continuously reinvented itself over two decades. Our invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined modern computer graphics, and revolutionized parallel computing! More recently, GPU deep learning ignited modern AI — the next era of computing. NVIDIA is a “learning machine” that constantly evolves by adapting to new opportunities which are hard to tackle, that only we can pursue, and that matter to the world. This is our life’s work, to amplify human inventiveness and intelligence. We are now looking for a motivated Senior DTCO Engineer, CPU Physical Design to join our dynamic and growing team. As a Senior DTCO Engineer, you will evaluate advanced semiconductor foundry nodes to optimize next-generation CPU microarchitecture. You will coordinate between foundry partners, IP development, and hardware design teams to explore target technology nodes during early development phases.
 What you'll be doing: 
 - Evaluate advanced process technologies and help shape technology choices for next-generation CPUs.
- Run synthesis, place-and-route, and static timing analysis to assess how process features affect power, performance, and area.
- Work with foundry, IP, and hardware design teams during early technology development.
- Use early pathfinding blocks to identify implementation bottlenecks and project technology-node scaling.
- Evaluate competitive products and benchmarks to understand technology and design trade-offs.
 What we need to see: 
 - Master’s or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
- 5+ years of relevant experience.
- Strong background in advanced-node silicon design and physical-design methodology.
- Ability to analyze physical implementation constraints and develop technology solutions to improve PPA.
- Proficiency with Python, Tcl, Perl, or similar scripting languages, as well as AI tools.
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 - Experience with DTCO or technology pathfinding for high-performance CPUs, GPUs, or AI accelerators.
- Expertise in advanced circuit and physical-design optimization, clocking, memory, or timing-closure techniques.
- A track record of translating test-chip or silicon data into measurable product improvements.
- Strong technical leadership, with the ability to collaborate across organizations and turn complex technical trade-offs into clear recommendations.

In partnership with regional Merchant and Acceptance teams and cross-functional partners around the globe, Mastercard’s Acceptance Solutions product management division in Europe works to expand merchant acceptance and help merchants and acquirers grow their businesses through Acceptance solutions and programs. At its essence, building acceptance is about driving the secular shift from cash to electronic payments, with the promise of giving consumers the best payment experience – one that’s fast, convenient, and secure.
The Acceptance Key Verticals Enablement lead will own commercial efforts to embed and optimize Mastercard carded payment solutions within EUR ecosystem, and secure the role that Mastercard’s card network will play in the segment as these areas evolve in the years and decades to come. 
With effective leadership, subject matter expertise, and many cross-functional stakeholders, this individual will identify, prioritize, and execute GoToMarket strategies to elevate consumer experiences and work with Acceptance teams to expand adoption of Mastercard capabilities within the acceptance ecosystem: merchant, channel partners, and customers that operate in verticals including telecom, utilities, education, government, and rent.

description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It's a unique legacy of innovation fueled by great technology—and amazing people. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and sits at the heart of our products and services. Every one of those GPUs starts life inside our silicon design environment, and that environment runs on the platform this team builds.
 We're looking for a Senior SRE to own and scale the Kubernetes platform that assists NVIDIA's chip design (EDA) workloads. This is not a generic container-platform role. You'll be running Kubernetes at the edges of what it was developed for: orchestrating enormous stateful jobs, license-constrained EDA tooling, latency-sensitive access to high-performance shared storage, and tenants whose tapeout schedules do not move. The clusters you run sit alongside some of the largest EDA compute farms in the industry, spanning multiple on-prem datacenters and multiple public clouds. When these clusters degrade, chip schedules feel it - which is exactly what makes the reliability work exciting.
 What you'll be doing: 
 - Own Kubernetes clusters end-to-end - plan, deliver, upgrade, day-2 operations, and decommission - across on-prem datacenters and managed cloud Kubernetes (e.g. EKS, GKE, RKE, Red Hat OpenShift, etc.).
- Define and implement the multi-cluster lifecycle strategy: version skew policy, patch cadence, node image pipelines, controlled rollouts, and safe upgrade mechanics for clusters that can't simply be drained on demand.
- Treat on-prem and CSP Kubernetes as one platform with consistent APIs, policy, and observability - not as two disconnected worlds.

- Partner with EDA engineering, storage, and network teams to land changes cleanly in a fast-moving environment.

- Interface directly with internal EDA tenants/engineering teams  to design and implement operational improvements to increase productivity and provide faster and more reliable outcomes as well as partner with the infrastructure services team to help architect the supporting  capabilities for intelligent workload routing, observability, dynamic scaling and resource governance.

At Pfizer, our mission is to create breakthroughs that change patients’ lives. We are seeking a Senior Manager, AI Experience Designer to design and deliver innovative, trustworthy, and impactful AI-powered experiences across Pfizer’s technology platforms.  
 This is a senior individual contributor role with meaningful ownership of the work and its outcomes. Working directly with Product, Engineering, Data, and AI partners, the Senior Manager turns ambiguous business and user needs into clear experience strategies, testable concepts, working prototypes, and production-ready designs.  
 The role requires deep expertise in Agentic AI and Conversational User Experience, including how AI systems communicate, take action, recover from failure, disclose uncertainty, and support effective human oversight. The successful candidate combines exceptional design craft with strong technical fluency, using Large Language Model APIs and agent frameworks to prototype real behavior rather than static interfaces.

The Senior Manager also contributes reusable approaches and standards that improve experience quality and consistency across Pfizer’s platforms.

 - End-to-End Experience Design: Own the design execution of complex AI-enabled products and workflows, from problem framing and research through prototyping, validation, detailed design, and implementation.   
 - Agentic and Conversational Design: Design AI experiences across chat, voice, and multimodal interactions, including conversation state, tool use, human oversight, approvals, escalation, error recovery, and safe fallback behaviors.   
 - Applied AI Prototyping: Use Large Language Model APIs, agent frameworks, and emerging AI tools to prototype realistic system behavior, test assumptions, and identify usability, trust, and safety risks before development.   
 - Product and Engineering Partnership: Work directly with Product and Engineering partners to shape scope, evaluate trade-offs, resolve implementation challenges, and ensure design intent is reflected in the delivered experience.   
 - Experience Quality and Craft: Deliver high-quality interaction, visual, and conversation design, applying strong judgment across usability, accessibility, trust, transparency, and regulated-content requirements.   
 - Rapid Validation and Delivery: Turn ambiguous ideas into testable concepts, proofs of concept, and production-ready designs, using evidence and user feedback to iterate quickly.   
 - Scalable Experience Practices: Contribute reusable interaction approaches, standards, frameworks, and patterns that improve consistency and experience quality across multiple products and platforms.  
 - Outcome Measurement: Define appropriate experience measures and use qualitative and quantitative evidence to evaluate adoption, task success, trust, usability, and overall product effectiveness.  
 ROLE BEHAVIOURS 
 - Don't Lose Your Curiosity: Experiments constantly with new AI design tools and methods on real work; shares what works and keeps their own practice current as the craft changes.  
 - Act with Agency: Gets just enough context and starts making; improvises around missing inputs, acts on partial information, and corrects course through the work itself rather than waiting for a plan. Pairs that bias to build with care for the craft: a strong sense of style, sweated interaction detail, and taste grounded in systems design.  
 - Raise the Craft Bar: Produces high-quality work that demonstrates strong judgment, modern design practice, and effective application of AI-enabled methods.  
 - Own the Outcome: Takes accountability for the quality, usability, adoption, and impact of the experiences they design, remaining engaged through implementation and post-release learning.  
 - Be Polymath Oriented: Combines interaction and conversation design with working technical knowledge of LLMs and agents; moves comfortably between design, product, and engineering contexts.  
 - Communicate with Precision: Writes specs and documentation engineers can build from directly; presents design rationale clearly to product and engineering partners.  
 - Think in Systems: Considers how individual interactions connect across workflows, products, platforms, data, and human and AI participants, creating approaches that scale beyond a single use case.

- Strong understanding of modern product development, front-end principles, APIs, and technical constraints, with the ability to collaborate effect

Our Purpose 
 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 Title and Summary 
Manager, Economic Modeling 
Overview
The Mastercard Economics Institute (MEI) is an economics lab that drives economic thought leadership in support of Mastercard's efforts to build a more inclusive and sustainable digital economy. The Economics Institute was launched in 2020 to analyze macroeconomic trends through the lens of the consumer to deliver tailored and actionable insights on economic issues for customers, partners and policymakers. The Institute is composed of a team of economists, data scientists and business strategists that utilize & synthesize the anonymized and aggregated data from the Mastercard network together with public data to bring powerful insights to life, in the form of 1:1 presentations, global thought leadership, media participation, and commercial work through our product partners
We are looking for a Causal Inference Economist to join the Economic Modeling team at the Mastercard Economics Institute. The Economic Modeling team is at the forefront of innovations to our Economics products and insights. In this role you will deliver insights using rich datasets, apply and develop econometric and machine learning tools, and work with both internal and external stakeholders at leading companies across different sectors.
Key responsibilities
• Translate broad business questions into well-defined causal effects, identification strategies, and empirical designs
• Develop causal analyses that help clients and internal teams understand the impacts of events, business decisions, market changes, and external shocks
• Lead projects over their full lifecycle – from data ingestion and feature engineering to model validation and communicating the results to key stakeholders 
• Guide usage of causal inference tools and of scientific best practices across the team 
• Prototype causal inference methods and help turn them into scalable, productized analytics
• Stay current with research methods and experiment with new approaches
About you
• Ph.D. or Master’s in Economics, Econometrics, Marketing, Finance, Public Policy or a closely related quantitative field
• Multiple years of relevant experience in a technically focused environment, although exceptional new PhDs may also be considered
•Proficiency in Python or R, and working knowledge of SQL 
• Strong training and experience applying quasi-experimental methods (difference-in-differences, synthetic control, RDD, IV, etc)
• Experience with causal machine-learning methods (double/debiased ML, meta learners, causal forests) and experimentation in a business setting
• Proficient in using AI tools for coding, research, documentation, and rapid prototyping, with appropriate validation and data-governance judgment
• Ability to communicate technical work clearly to non-specialists, in writing and in client presentations

 Job Description: 
 The Role and Impact 
 We are seeking a Silicon Packaging Design Architect to join our team, where you will drive end-to-end package solutions for physical, electrical, and cost requirements. In this senior engineering role, you will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, troubleshoot, and continuously improve packaging standards and processes, ensuring high-quality package output. Your contributions will directly impact the seamless transition of designs to production and enhance Intel's advanced packaging technologies.
 Business Group 
As part of Intel Corporation's dynamic and innovative ecosystem, this role resides within the Silicon Packaging Architecture team, focused on developing advanced packaging solutions that enable Intel's cutting-edge silicon technologies. The team plays a vital role in ensuring packaging, and 3D IC designs meet technical, mechanical, and reliability standards while supporting Intel's broader mission to drive world-changing advancements in technology.

 - Translate product requirements into detailed package architecture specifications. 
- Drive technology tradeoff decisions to ensure silicon packages conform to electrical, mechanical, thermal, and reliability standards. 
- Collaborate with silicon, hardware, and package teams to deliver high-quality package solutions and overcome roadblocks. 
- Oversee the end-to-end package development process, including design, procedures, and continuous improvements to quality standards. 
- Troubleshoot packaging designs and resolve issues related to materials and processes, providing innovative and cost-effective solutions. 
- Implement co-design strategies between silicon and board design teams to optimize product performance and cost.
- Collaborate with EDA partners to advance package design tools and optimize design methods.
 Core Competencies 
 - Strong analytical, communication, and organizational skills. 
- Proven ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a dynamic environment.

ROLE SUMMARY 
 Regulatory Quality Assurance (RQA) is an independent Quality audit function accountable to identify risks and non-compliance associated with Pfizer’s GxP regulated operations. Within RQA, the GMP GDP Audit function is responsible for performing GMP / GDP audits of Pfizer manufacturing and distribution operations, Pfizer license entities, Pfizer country offices, material suppliers, service providers, commercial/clinical manufacturing sites and contract manufacturers that are involved in GMP/ GDP manufacturing, packaging, testing and distribution of APIs, clinical trial materials and commercial biopharmaceutical products worldwide. 
 The RQA GMP GDP Audit function is accountable to ensure Pfizer manufacturing and distribution operations are compliant with all applicable global GMP/GDP regulations/standards and Pfizer Quality Standards. The RQA GMP GDP Audit function is required to understand GMP /GDP regulations worldwide and apply this expertise when performing audits, to provide assurance against regulator’s interpretation and expectations for compliance with cGMP/GDP requirements. 
 ROLE RESPONSIBILITIES 
 - Independently plans/leads/participates in audits of Pfizer manufacturing and distribution operations, Pfizer license entities, Pfizer country offices, material suppliers, service providers, commercial/clinical manufacturing sites and contract manufacturers performing initial and routine audits , managing/leading with minimum oversight 
- Leverages responsible use of AI tools to support targeted audit preparation and execution 
- May engage with more complex audits including process audits or serve as a reviewer of low complexity, outsourced audits 
- Supports and executes on quality programs related to functional areas, specific vendor entities and/or assessments 
- Has GMP GDP working knowledge and is called upon to resolve issues based on knowledge of relevant SOPs (Standard Operating Procedures), GMP GDP regulations/standards, as well as local regulations and standards 
- Works with RQA colleagues on cross GxP audit plans as required 
- Ability to manage multiple stakeholders to synthesize feedback and take action with support from Manager 
 BASIC QUALIFICATIONS

description:
About the role
 Adobe’s Security Data Platform team builds and operates a petabyte-scale security data lakehouse that turns enterprise telemetry into trusted data for threat detection, investigations, compliance, and security analytics.
 As a Staff Security Data Engineer, you will own full-system designs and lead critical engineering initiatives across ingestion, storage, governance, orchestration, and data serving. This is a hands-on individual contributor role: you will write and review production code, build infrastructure, define test strategy, fix complex failures, and work with other engineers to deliver the architecture you help shape.
 You will partner with Security Operations, Threat Intelligence, Compliance, Security Engineering, and infrastructure teams to resolve technical tradeoffs and deliver reliable, cost-effective platform capabilities. Your impact will come through engineering delivery, sound architectural decisions, and helping others become stronger technical leaders.
 Help us evolve our team from petabyte scale toward exabyte scale!
 Core responsibilities
 Platform architecture and engineering
 - Own end-to-end designs that shape the Security Data Platform’s fundamental architecture on Databricks and AWS, using Spark, Delta Lake, and Unity Catalog. Translate ambiguous needs into design proposals, implementation plans, and production capabilities.
- Build and evolve distributed batch and streaming pipelines for EDR telemetry, network logs, identity events, cloud audit logs, and new security data sources. Design for throughput, fault tolerance, replay, schema evolution, and sub-minute freshness where use cases require it.
- Write maintainable Python and SQL, develop complex platform features, and refactor unreliable code. Establish reusable engineering patterns, lead code and design reviews, and own test strategy and automation choices across pipelines and infrastructure.
- Build and maintain tested, reusable Terraform modules for AWS and Databricks infrastructure, including S3, IAM, VPC networking, and Amazon Managed Workflows for Apache Airflow (MWAA). Automate delivery through version control and CI/CD.
 Data modeling governance and operations
 - Design layered lakehouse data models and reusable normalization patterns, including Open Cybersecurity Schema Framework (OCSF) mappings where appropriate. Preserve source fidelity and make datasets useful for investigations, analytics, and detection workloads.
- Establish data contracts, quality checks, cataloging, classification, lineage, access controls, and retention policies with data owners. Use Unity Catalog to make data ownership and governance traceable from raw events to analyst-facing datasets.
- Engineer and operate Airflow and MWAA orchestration, including dependencies, retries, backfills, alerting, and automated recovery. Define service level objectives with consumers and instrument data freshness, completeness, pipeline health, and query performance.
- Lead diagnosis and resolution of complex production issues across Spark, storage, orchestration, and cloud infrastructure. Improve incident response, runbooks, recovery testing, and operational readiness to prevent recurring failures.
 Performance and technical leadership
 - Profile workloads and lead measurable cost and performance improvements through query and Spark tuning, storage lifecycle policies, partitioning, and compute right-sizing. Establish baselines and dashboards that show savings alongside reliability, latency, and capacity.
- Lead cross-team technical discussions, reconcile competing requirements, and build agreement on architecture and delivery priorities without formal management authority. Communicate decisions, landmarks, risks, and business impact proactively to your manager and partners.
- Partner with detection and security analytics engineers to deliver the data interfaces, governance, and pipeline capabilities needed for SIEM modernization and automated detection deployment.
- Mentor engineers through pairing, technical reviews, documentation, and knowledge sharing. Help others lead technical work, promote inclusive debate, and contribute to hiring decisions through technical assessment.
- Evaluate and introduce useful platform innovations, including AI-assisted engineering and operational automation. Validate outputs, protect sensitive security data, measure improvements, and help partner teams adopt proven approaches.
 Required qualifications
 - Substantial experience building and operating production data platforms, typically 10 or more years in data or software engineering, with demonstrated Staff-level scope and impact. Equivalent depth and outcomes are welcome; a prior Staff or Principal title is not required.
- A record of personally delivering complex distributed systems and leading full-system design and implementation across team boundaries. Ability to turn general, unstructured assignments into clear technical approaches and working software.

description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people.  As a member of the HW Infrastructure Storage Strategy team, you will provide leadership in the research, design and implementation of ground breaking fast storage solutions to enable runs of demanding high performance computing, and computationally intensive workloads. We seek an expert to identify architectural changes encompassing file, block, and object storage, to cater to the scaling and performance requirements of an expanding cloud infrastructure. As an expert, you will help us with the next-gen storage solutions strategic challenges we encounter with storage design for large scale, high performance workloads, evolving our private/public cloud strategy, capacity modelling, and growth planning across our global computing environment.
 What you'll be doing: 
 - Research and analyze existing internal distributed storage services.
- Research, design, and implement scalable, next-gen distributed storage services for HPC workloads, optimizing both performance and cost-effectiveness to meet NVIDIA’s growing infrastructure needs
- Develop tooling to automate management of large-scale infrastructure environments, to automate operational monitoring and alerting, and to enable self-service consumption of resources.
- Detail the general procedures and practices, perform technology evaluations, related to distributed file systems.
- Collaborate across teams to better understand developers' workflows and capture their infrastructure requirements.

- Supporting our researchers to run their flows on our clusters including performance analysis and optimizations of deep learning workflows
- Root cause analysis and suggest corrective action for problems large and small scales
 What we need to see: 
 - Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering or related field or equivalent experience.
- 8+ years of experience designing and/or operating large scale storage infrastructure.
- Experience analyzing and tuning storage performance for a variety of workloads.
- Proficient in Centos/RHEL and/or Ubuntu Linux distros including Python programming and bash scripting
- In depth understanding of container technologies like Docker, Enroot
 Ways to stand out from the crowd: 
 - Distributed Storage Expertise: Extensive experience with parallel and distributed filesystems (Ceph, Weka.io, Vast, Lustre, GPFS) and Linux storage kernel development.
- GPU & AI Infrastructure: Proficient with NVIDIA GPUs, CUDA programming, and NCCL, including performance benchmarking via MLPerf.
