Reporting directly to the Vice President, Business Strategy, South LAC, with a dual reporting line to the COVEC Cluster Lead, this role leads Mastercard’s strategy agenda across Colombia, Ecuador, Venezuela, Guyana, and Suriname, while supporting broader South Division priorities.
As a member of both the South LAC Strategy team and the COVEC Leadership Team, the role partners across the organization to shape strategic priorities, identify new growth opportunities, evaluate investments and business initiatives, support key decision-making processes, and drive execution against critical business objectives. The position works closely with leadership teams across markets, products, services, operations, finance, legal, public affairs, people, and other functions to ensure alignment, mobilize resources, and deliver measurable business impact.
The role serves as a trusted advisor to senior leadership, helping translate market opportunities, industry trends, and business challenges into actionable strategies that accelerate growth, strengthen Mastercard’s competitive position, and support the delivery of cluster and divisional objectives.
Key Responsibilities
• Lead the development and execution of Mastercard’s strategic priorities across COVEC and support selected South Division initiatives.
• Identify, assess, and prioritize growth opportunities across customers, products, services, payment flows, partnerships, and emerging business models.
• Develop market assessments, business cases, financial analyses, strategic recommendations, and investment evaluations to support decision-making and resource allocation.
• Drive strategic initiatives from concept through execution, coordinating across multiple stakeholders and ensuring alignment with business objectives.
• Support annual strategic planning, business reviews, operating reviews, and executive governance processes.
• Monitor performance against strategic objectives and key business metrics, identifying risks, opportunities, and actions required to drive results.
• Develop presentations, reports, and recommendations for regional, divisional, and global leadership audiences.
• Provide insights on industry trends, competitive dynamics, regulatory developments, and emerging opportunities impacting Mastercard and its customers.
• Support special projects, executive requests, and other high-priority initiatives across the cluster and division.
All About You
• 8+ years of experience in strategy, management consulting, business development, financial services, payments, fintech, or related industries.
• Demonstrated ability to lead complex strategic and cross-functional initiatives in dynamic environments.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including business case development, market assessment, financial analysis, and strategic planning.
• Ability to synthesize complex information into clear insights and actionable recommendations.
• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and drive alignment across a matrixed organization.
• Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills, including experience preparing materials for executive audiences.
• Self-starter with strong project management skills and a proven ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Bachelor’s degree required; MBA or other advanced degree preferred.
• Fluent in English and Spanish. 
 Corporate Security Responsibility 
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
 - Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
- Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
- Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
- Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

 Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential. 
 Title and Summary 
Vice President, Cybersecurity Strategy and Engagement 
Overview:
The Vice President, Cybersecurity Strategy and Engagement will serve as a senior strategic leader to help set direction, prioritize efforts, and drive execution across Mastercard's global government cybersecurity engagement portfolio. This individual will act as a close collaborator and thought partner to the SVP, Cybersecurity Partnership and Engagement, owning critical workstreams, building out a global strategy for government engagement, representing Mastercard with senior government and institutional counterparts, and ensuring that the organization's engagement activities are coherent, well-sequenced, and impactful.
This role requires executive presence, sound strategic judgment, and a deep understanding of the global cybersecurity landscape — including the policy, threat intelligence, and technology dimensions that shape government priorities.
Role:
– Partner closely with the SVP to develop and execute Mastercard's global government cybersecurity engagement strategy, ensuring efforts are aligned across geographies, institutions, and internal stakeholders.
– Help lead the design, structure, and ongoing operation of senior-level government engagement mechanisms, including advisory councils, working groups, and executive roundtables.
– Support the operation and continued development of Mastercard's Global Security Advisory Council (GSAC), including member engagement, meeting preparation, follow-through on Council priorities, and coordination with GSAC leadership and internal stakeholders.
– Identify, prioritize, and advance opportunities for Mastercard to engage with key government and institutional counterparts, including national cybersecurity agencies, critical infrastructure bodies, and multilateral organizations.
– Serve as a senior representative of the function in external meetings, conferences, and engagements, projecting authority and credibility on behalf of Mastercard's cybersecurity mission.
– Coordinate internally across Security Solutions, product, sales, legal, and communications teams to ensure government engagement strategies are well-supported and commercially informed.
– Track the global policy and threat intelligence landscape to identify emerging opportunities and risks relevant to Mastercard's government engagement priorities.
– Support the development of briefing materials, executive communications, and strategic documents that position Mastercard as a thought leader and trusted partner in cybersecurity.
– Help manage and develop the broader Cybersecurity Partnership & Engagement team, contributing to organizational effectiveness and culture.
About You:
– Extensive years of experience in cybersecurity, national security, or government affairs — with demonstrated experience engaging with senior government or institutional stakeholders.
– Deep familiarity with the global cybersecurity policy and threat intelligence landscape, including critical infrastructure protection, international cyber norms, and the evolving role of the private sector.
– Proven ability to operate strategically and execute operationally, comfortable both setting direction and driving results.
– Strong executive presence and communication skills; experience representing organizations at senior levels in government, industry, and multilateral forums.
– Experience working across complex, matrixed organizations and building alignment among diverse stakeholders.
– Prior experience in cybersecurity, international engagement, financial services, critical infrastructure, and/or technology sectors preferred.
– Government service, intelligence community, or national security background highly valued.
– Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree in international affairs, cybersecurity, public policy, or a related field preferred.
WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE:
This individual will develop a global cybersecurity engagement strategy for Mastercard, including the prioritization of government engagement opportunities and key partnership engagements The individual will establish strong internal and external relationships – and will ensure Mastercard’s government cybersecurity engagement function operates with increasing coherence, efficiency, and impact, and that Mastercard is consistently seen as a trusted partner, strategic advisor, and leading voice by governments around the world.

Job Details: 
 Job Description: 
 The Role and Impact    
 You will be part of a highly skilled, agile design/verification team developing cutting-edge hardware for the NIC, IPU and AI domains.   
 As a senior IP Design Verification Engineer, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the functionality and reliability of complex designs. You will technically lead teams in developing verification plans, creating test benches, and building environments to thoroughly validate meaningful parts of the chip — complex IPs and subsystems.   
 Your work will directly contribute to identifying and resolving bugs in the pre-silicon environment using simulation and/or Formal Property Verification techniques, ensuring robust designs that meet high-performance standards.   
 We are intentional, fast adopters of AI as a working tool. We bring modern AI assistants and automation into every part of the verification flow — planning, stimulus and checker development, coverage analysis, debug and more.   
 Business group   
You will be joining Intel's Central Engineering Group (CEG), a global organization responsible for designing and verifying industry-leading IPs and architectures that power Intel's NIC, IPU and ASIC products. The group produces innovative technologies and solutions for hyperscalers, cloud providers, networking, AI and other specialized workloads.   
 As part of this dynamic team, you will contribute to Intel's commitment to advancing silicon and system innovation.  
 Key Responsibilities    
 - Own verification planning and execution for key IP features across IP and subsystem integration points   
 - Build scalable verification environments and targeted test plans with reusable test benches, checkers, VIPs, and behavioral models   
 - Collaborate closely with architecture, design, and software teams from specification through bringup; contribute across role boundaries when needed to unblock progress and maintain execution quality   
 - Drive ownership of multiple critical blocks and verification components; take full responsibility for functional signoffs and achievement of performance and power metrics   
 - Lead IP delivery to multiple customers while ensuring technical excellence; balance competing requirements, schedules, and resources across teams   
 - Drive convergence of simulation and formal verification into unified bug hunting and coverage closure strategies; evaluate and adopt emerging methodologies including ML-driven verification flows   
 - Mentor and develop verification engineers; establish verification best practices and raise team-level execution quality   
 - Comfortable using AI-assisted development tools as part of everyday workflow; track record of delivering reusable, configurable verification collateral

 Minimum Qualifications   
 - Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.

- Proficiency in creating IP test environments and/or using formal verification methods  
- Strong knowledge of digital design fundamentals and microarchitecture principles.

 - Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field with relevant experience in design verification.

Job Details: 
 Job Description: 
 The Role and Impact   
     You will be part of a highly skilled, agile design/verification team developing cutting-edge hardware for the NIC, IPU and AI domains.   
 As an IP Design Verification Engineer, you will play a crucial role in ensuring the functionality and reliability of complex designs. You will develop verification plans, create test benches, and build environments to thoroughly validate meaningful parts of the chip — complex IPs and subsystems.   
 Your work will directly contribute to identifying and resolving bugs in the pre-silicon environment using simulation and/or Formal Property Verification techniques, ensuring robust designs that meet high-performance standards.   
 We are intentional, fast adopters of AI as a working tool. We bring modern AI assistants and automation into every part of the verification flow — planning, stimulus and checker development, coverage analysis, debug and more.   
 Business group   
 You will be joining Intel's Central Engineering Group (CEG), a global organization responsible for designing and verifying industry-leading IPs and architectures that power Intel's NIC, IPU and ASIC products. The group produces innovative technologies and solutions for hyperscalers , cloud providers, networking, AI and other specialized workloads.   
 As part of this dynamic team, you will contribute to Intel's commitment to advancing silicon and system innovation.   
 Key Responsibilities   
 - Develop and execute IP verification plans, ensuring thorough coverage of microarchitecture specifications.   
 - Design and implement test benches and verification environments to validate functionality and reliability.   
 - Utilize AI and simulation models to analyze power, timing, and uncover bugs.   
 - Debug, identify root causes, and implement corrective measures for failing tests in the pre-silicon environment.   
 - Collaborate closely with architects, designers, DFT, and emulation/bring- up  teams to ensure correctness from block to system level.   
 - Maintain and improve existing functional verification methodologies and infrastructure.   
 - Document test plans, participate in technical reviews, and drive verification improvements.   
 Qualifications: 
 Minimum Qualifications   
 - Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering , Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related fields .   
 - 5+ years of experience in functional design verification of ASIC, SOC or FPGA designs with expertise in System Verilog, OVM/UVM, and debugging tools.   
 - Proficiency in creating IP test environments and/or using formal verification methods   
 - Strong knowledge of digital design fundamentals and microarchitecture principles.   
 Preferred Qualifications   
 - Master's or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or related field with relevant experience in design verification.   
 - Experience with formal property verification, System Verilog Assertions, code and functional coverage implementation and analysis   
 - Experience collaborating across teams to drive architectural improvements.   
 - Use of AI tools would be an advantage. At a minimum, require someone that is passionate about performing Pre-Silicon DV harnessing the power of AI.   
 - Experience with switching/routing and communications protocols such as Ethernet, and Cryptographic Protocols such IPSec, DTLS and MACSec .   
 - Experience with AMBA protocols such as APB and AXI.   
 - Experience with languages such as SystemC , Python, Perl, Shell scripting and how AI can be used to integrate these in verification flows.   
 We invite you to bring your expertise and enthusiasm to a team where your contributions will drive technological progress and create opportunities for impactful learning and growth.

description:
The Opportunity
 As a Technical Account Manager, you will serve as the primary technical advisor for a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers in Mexico. You will build trusted relationships, help customers improve how they gain value from their Adobe investments, and maintain an outstanding customer experience throughout the engagement.
 This role offers the opportunity to collaborate with world-class technical teams and senior leaders. It involves translating customers’ business priorities into clear technical strategies, operational plans, and measurable outcomes. You will proactively identify risks, uncover optimization opportunities, and orchestrate the appropriate Adobe resources to help customers achieve their long-term goals.
 Responsibilities
 - Serve as the primary technical advisor and point of coordination for a portfolio of strategic enterprise customers
- Build and maintain trusted relationships with practitioners, technical leaders, managers, directors, and C-level executives
- Translate complex business objectives into actionable technical strategies, success plans, and operational priorities
- Proactively identify customer needs, technical risks, and opportunities for optimization, adoption, and long-term improvement
- Orchestrate the resolution of complex technical issues by coordinating across Adobe Engineering, TechOps, Managed Services, Support, Product, and other internal teams
- Establish clear expectations and maintain consistent communication through regular checkpoints, status reviews, governance meetings, and planning sessions.
- Conduct in-depth assessments of customers’ technical environments to identify architectural risks, performance concerns, integration challenges, and opportunities for improvement
- Provide strategic advice on implementation approaches, technical guidelines, scalability, performance, integrations, and operational readiness
- Co-lead Quarterly Business Reviews, executive briefings, and technical presentations, connecting the realities of the customer’s technical environment with business priorities and measurable outcomes
- Maintain structured oversight of open actions, technical dependencies, risks, and critical issues, ensuring clear ownership and timely follow-through
- Advocate for customers within Adobe while balancing their priorities with technical feasibility, product capabilities, and internal commitments
- Collaborate across Adobe teams to deliver a coordinated and consistent customer experience
 Required Qualifications, Capabilities, and Skills
 - Bachelor’s degree in a technical, business, or related field, or equivalent professional experience
- Seven or more years of experience in Technical Account Management, technical consulting, solution architecture, or another senior customer-facing technical role
- Demonstrated success managing complex enterprise customer relationships in a consultative capacity
- Good understanding of marketing technology, advertising technology, and AI-powered solutions, including their application within complex enterprise environments
- Strong knowledge of web technologies, including JavaScript, jQuery, Java, HTML/HTML5, CSS, REST APIs, and database technologies
- Solid understanding of tag management, digital data collection, and enterprise implementation methodologies
- Experience solving issues, performance-tuning, and optimizing web/app environments
- Ability to read and interpret code, fix technical implementations, and understand third-party integrations at the API level
- Familiarity with Agile and Scrum development methodologies
- Strong executive presence, with the ability to communicate effectively with and influence senior technical and business leaders
- Ability to develop and deliver clear, compelling executive presentations
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both Spanish and English
- Strong emotional intelligence, active listening skills, and the ability to navigate complex or sensitive customer conversations
- Demonstrated ability to manage conflict, balance competing priorities, and drive alignment across multiple interested parties
- Strong ownership and follow-through, supported by a structured approach to tracking, prioritizing, and closing complex technical and business actions
- Excellent organization, prioritization, and time-management skills
- Willingness to travel approximately 15–20% of the time and availability for recurring onsite work at both Adobe offices and customer locations
 Preferred Qualifications
 - Experience with Adobe Experience Cloud solutions
- Experience supporting large-scale digital experience, marketing technology, analytics, content management, advertising technology, customer data, or AI platforms
- Experience working with distributed, multi-functional teams in a global enterprise environment
 Join us in delivering exceptional customer experiences and shaping the future of digital transformation.

 Title and Summary 
Executive Assistant 
Executive Assistant, Mastercard Risk
London
Overview:
• This London, UK based position reports to the EVP, Risk Strategy and Transformation, Mastercard Risk. 
• The Executive Assistant is responsible for providing:
1) full administrative support to the EVP, Risk Strategy and Transformation 
2) limited administrative support to 3-4 SVPs in the Mastercard Risk function
• The role includes performing general assistance across departmental/office activities
• Seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented, energetic, calm under pressure, and experienced Executive Assistant to create a positive and collaborative team culture.
Role: 
The Executive Assistant will assist daily with time sensitive and highly confidential matters, including but not limited to regulatory, Risk Committee and entity Board materials and other items such as those relating to Group and Regulated Entity Risk Management, Risk and Control incidents/improvements, and Risk organization personnel. As such, the ability to handle such matters with insight is critical. As the administrative liaison, and a member of Mastercard Risk, we are looking for someone that embodies the Mastercard Way by doing the right thing by demonstrating decency, inclusion, and being a force for good.
Responsibilities include:
• Distribute meeting materials; screening email and telephone calls; electronically filing documents; ordering supplies, and maintaining department records, and other duties, as assigned.
• Partner with senior executive assistants within the Mastercard Risk function as back-up admin.
• Prepare correspondence; email; reports; presentations or other assigned documentation. 
• Assist EVP’s chief of staff with planning leadership meetings, offsites, broader team meetings and client engagements. 
• Organize and coordinate team meetings and communication flow withing the team.
• Develop and produce team reports, as assigned.
• Maintain and update internal and external distribution lists for email correspondence.
• Administer programs; projects or processes specific to the operating unit served; and maintain spreadsheets or databases to monitor departmental information.
• Perform general administrative duties for EVP and SVPs to support day-to-day department operations in such areas as calendar management, scheduling meetings, managing travel arrangements (including passports and visas as needed), and expense reporting.
• May research special topics, as assigned.
• May assist in preparing and maintaining departmental budget.
• May monitor and coordinate work of other employees or temporary/contract resources. 
All About You:
• Demonstrated professionalism and discretion, and experience in working with highly confidential information.
• Extremely collaborative and fostering a positive spirit and can-do attitude and is also extremely open in accepting feedback and suggestions. 
• Adherence to the Mastercard Risk Team Agreement for Return to Office Company Strategy.
• Extensive administrative experience in a corporate environment interfacing with c-suite executive level management, senior customers, and board members.
• Proficiency in Outlook and competency across the Microsoft Office suite including Word, Excel, PowerPoint.
• Experience with expense management platforms (such as Oracle).
• Experience in harmonizing across matrixed, cross functional and global organization structure.
• Experience in supporting senior level executives in a fast-paced corporate work environment.
• Must be proactive and solution oriented, looking for ways to add value and assist the team.
Strong communication skills (written and verbal).
• Intrinsically motivated, highly organized, detail-oriented and results-oriented.
• Able to work well under deadlines, anticipate needs and prioritize work accordingly. 
 Corporate Security Responsibility 
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
 - Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
- Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
- Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
- Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
